title: The Legend of More Bounce
subtitle: One tiny world seen three ways: overworld, side-view action, and first-person interaction.
tagline: One world. Three ways of seeing it.
short_description: A tiny retro adventure that jumps between three classic ways of seeing a game world.
long_description: The Legend of More Bounce is a compact handcrafted PixelForge adventure starring More Bounce and Princess Larrina. Cross a top-down overworld, enter Wobble Woods as a side-scrolling action scene, recover the Bounce Rune, then step through the Echo Gate into a first-person tower encounter. One shared state follows you through all three perspectives. Built for the 369 PocketGames lane: paid once, offline-friendly, no ads, no subscriptions, and no predatory purchases.
feature_bullets: Three perspectives inside one tiny shared world
Top-down overworld exploration, side-view action, and first-person interaction
A complete proof-sized adventure with a clear beginning and ending
Local-first play with no account, telemetry, or network requirement
Paid-once 369 PocketGames design with no ads or predatory IAP
release_note: Production-candidate metadata packet. Store submission/signing is outside PixelForge v5.6.
